items.title: X lets users clip 5 to 60 seconds of your video.
items.para: Clips from videos of two minutes or more carry the creator's handle and a link back to the original.
items.tip: Post full-length press conferences and match reviews: fan clips point back to your account.

items.title: TikTok's Social MCP lets brands ask AI about trends.
items.para: Brands can run social listening, trend analysis and sentiment tracking through a conversation with AI.
items.tip: Test it on one signing or rivalry to see which fan conversations are rising.

items.title: Symphony now makes AI ad videos of 30 seconds.
items.para: The Seedance upgrade takes up to 50 references, up from 9, and doubles the earlier 15-second cap.
items.tip: Try AI drafts for sponsor and ticket ads, using club-approved footage as references.

items.title: LinkedIn matches posts to profile context.
items.para: A Profile Relevance model scores non-connection posts on topic, location, job title, company and industry.
items.tip: Make the professional context clear in sponsorship and hiring posts.

items.title: Meta's Muse now builds mini apps called Spaces.
items.para: A request becomes a mini app stored in the Muse sidebar, such as a tracker or an activity log.
items.tip: Prototype a matchday checklist or a sponsor-deliverables tracker in a Space.
